By: Ben Myhre
Published: Tuesday, January 2, 2018 - 9:34am

Ingredients




1 Tablespoon Ginger, grated
1 Cup of water
1 3 Ounce Packet of Lime Jell-O
½ Cup of Vodka
½ Cup of Ginger Beer
Small plastic or paper cups

Preparation

1 Add Grated Ginger to 1 cup of water 2 In saucepan, add ginger water mixture and bring to a boil 3 In separate mixing bowl, add Jell-O powder 4 Strain ginger from boiling water 5 Add boiling water to mixing bowl 6 Whisk until fully blended 7 Add Vodka, ginger beer and mix 8 Pour liquid into cups, approximately 2 ounces per serving

About

We are bringing the awesome Moscow Mule flavors to the party snacks of Jell-O shots. If you have ever made a Moscow Mule, you know that the ingredients are vodka, ginger beer, and lime. These Jell-O shots are a fun way to spice up your parties and impress your friends. Fun for parties or tailgating where Jell-O shots already are fun. They take about as long to make as Jell-O and are super simple to make.
